name: Animated Story Maker
tagline: Turns a premise into a short 3D episode plus per-scene prompts
description: Hand it a story idea, a mood, or pictures of the characters you have in mind and it plans a short three-dimensional animated episode around them. You get the scene breakdown plus a paste-ready generation prompt for every shot, so rendering happens on your side. Keeps a cast consistent across instalments.
author: karatademada
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
